headline: ODE models link fitted parameters to zygotic transition and yeast protein inheritance
label: Mechanistic Models Of Regulation
summary: Fitted ODE models now tie regulatory parameters to zygotic transition and inheritance in yeast lineages, beyond descriptive embeddings alone.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the use of explicit model structure to recover regulatory organization from expression or imaging measurements. A semi-mechanistic ODE transcription model fitted to zebrafish RNA-seq derives expression clusters tied to maternal-to-zygotic transition dynamics, and PRNODE jointly estimates mother and daughter protein regulatory networks with a fused group-lasso to quantify inheritance in yeast live-cell imaging. ELLA-mix applies a finite mixture model to detect cell subpopulations with distinct radial RNA localization. Other items rely on statistical mixture estimation, explainable machine learning of chromatin locus dynamics, and a Python toolkit for transcription factor clustering in 4D microscopy. What is new is the explicit linkage of fitted parameters to inheritance and transition biology, rather than descriptive embeddings alone.
